angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 603,868 km at 36.97 pc = 0.22 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 27.0521 +/- 0.0168 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 36.97 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.868 +/- 0.006 solar radii from Kálmán et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 95338 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract): 603,868 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.848 +/- 0.047 solar masses from Kálmán et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 95338 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5097 +/- 77 K from Kálmán et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 95338 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Kálmán et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 95338 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-95338.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.489, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95338 (pscomppars): spectral type K0.5 V, from Díaz et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.496.4330D/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95338 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Kálmán et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95338 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.3098, from Díaz et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.496.4330D/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95338 (pscomppars): age 9.5 Gyr, from Kálmán et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95338 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.23 km/s, from Kálmán et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A.240K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
